review_input.original_instruction: Looking at the picnic table inside, walk directly at the right hand corner of the picnic table, closest to the fridge. Once you get there, turn back around and head, facing the TV, couch and chairs, to the left there is an open doorway, walk back through that open doorway, in the area of which you came. You're now in a bedroom, walk to the foot of the bed, between the TV and the bed, walk past the Jacuzzi tub into the open doorway straight ahead. In the open doorway, the toilet on your left, turn to the right. You'll see a shower, walk into the shower. Standing in the shower, you've reached your final destination.
